data.title: 胡桃 · 堂主密室檀木初绽
data.description: 往生堂幽静雅致的内室中檀香袅袅，红木软榻上铺着大红金线织锦。胡桃身着一件别致的国风绯红丝缎小衣，一腿屈起侧坐于织锦靠枕间。她手中握着一把精致的折扇轻掩下颔，梅花瞳孔流转着古灵精怪又带一丝女儿娇羞的光彩，暖红烛火与沉香白烟在身周盘旋，宛如红梅初绽般夺目动人。
data.location: 往生堂幽静内室檀香软榻
data.action: 侧坐于红锦软榻，一腿屈起，一手持折扇掩颔，梅花眸带笑，直视观众挑眉巧笑
data.lighting: 暖红烛光与檀香缭绕的朦胧光影
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, cowboy shot, eye level
data.mood: 古灵精怪少女的独处风雅与俏皮
data.promptProse: Hu Tao sits cross-legged in the secret parlor chamber facing the viewer, wrapped in crimson silk that accentuates her bare shoulders, collarbone, and cleavage; glowing blue spirit flames illuminate her plum blossom eyes and teasing smile in the fragrant sandalwood air.
data.animaCaption: Cross-legged in the secret chamber facing the viewer, her crimson silk wrap showcases her collarbone, cleavage, and bare midriff amid spirit flames.
